annotations.title: List B2A Data Streams & Schemas

cleanProvenanceBadge: 100% First-Party & Open Government Licensed (commercial_resell_ok — Zero ToS-violating portal scraping)
description: Free ($0, no auth), read-only, idempotent catalog listing all 16 B2A streams, pricing, licenses, and schemas. Pass category or streamId (default category="all", includeLegacyAliases=false); returns stream entries ordered by catalog index with SHA-256 provenance. Note: For stock checks, use probe_stream_inventory instead.

category.description: Optional B2A domain category filter ("all" returns all 16 streams ordered by catalog index).

includeLegacyAliases.description: When true, includes backward-compatible Phase-7 and specialized verb tool aliases for each stream.

streamId.description: Optional canonical B2A stream slug from the 16-stream enum; when provided, returns the full inputSchema, outputSchema, and parameter defaults for that stream.

name: list_data_streams

canonicalToolsCount.description: Number of canonical 3-word MCP tools exposed in default tools/list (18).

legacyCallableToolsCount.description: Number of backward-compatible legacy and Phase-7 tool aliases callable via tools/call.

matchedStreamsCount.description: Number of streams matching the requested category or streamId filter.

ok.description: True when the free 1st-floor stream catalog introspection succeeded.

selectedStreamSchema.description: Populated when streamId is specified, containing full inputSchema, outputSchema, and parameterDefaults.

sha256Digest.description: Deterministic 64-character hex SHA-256 digest of the returned stream catalog payload.

sourceRightsRegistry.description: Open-government and first-party commercial-resell license and attribution ledger.

streams.description: Ordered array of B2A stream metadata entries including canonicalToolName, modes, and x402 pricing.

totalCallableToolsCount.description: Total unique deduplicated tool names callable via tools/call and ?profile=full.

totalStreams.description: Total commercial B2A data streams available on the server (16).
